Resistance to single-block, low-liquidity, or replay-based price manipulation

history.rationale: WHY NOW: WooracleV2 is a central oracle component and its prices can directly determine swaps, pool quotes, collateral-like valuations, or settlement amounts across dependent contracts; it is unvisited and therefore offers high-impact coverage of the primary price-manipulation surface. frame_4b81d2251e7d.question: Vulnerability analysis of WOOFiDexDepositor
artifact_refs: Swap pricing and quote-source integrity
Enforcement of minimum output parameters against manipulated execution prices
Owner-configured vault and token routing effects on deposit valuation
Whether pause and slippage controls prevent value extraction during price manipulation

history.rationale: WHY NOW: This unvisited contract performs swaps before depositing into configured vaults and exposes a minimum-output control, making it a concentrated price-manipulation boundary that may rely on router pricing or caller-supplied assumptions. It is a major component outside the already completed oracle and vault investigations, and its integration could convert manipulated swap prices into mispriced vault deposits. EXIT CRITERIA: Trace every deposit and swap path through the configured router and vaults, identify the authoritative price source and all slippage checks, verify whether attacker-controlled or stale/manipulated prices can satisfy them, and conclude whether a profitable price-manipulation path exists or document the complete mitigating invariant.

frame_b32dbafcfe3c.question: Vulnerability analysis of WooCrossChainRouterV2
artifact_refs: Trace source-chain and destination-chain quote and swap amount calculations
Check whether WooRouterV2 oracle-priced execution is protected by caller-controlled minimum-output or slippage bounds
Review owner-configured router and slippage parameters for paths that permit manipulated prices to produce excessive cross-chain output or unfavorable settlement
Examine fee and bridged-amount accounting for price-dependent inconsistencies

history.rationale: WHY NOW: This is an unvisited major component that directly calls WooRouterV2, an oracle-priced swap system, and exposes owner-configured slippage behavior across a cross-chain boundary. EXIT CRITERIA: Trace every price-dependent ingress and egress path, identify all oracle/quote inputs and slippage checks, verify that manipulated prices cannot authorize excess output or bypass minimum-output protection, and either document concrete exploit evidence or conclude no price-manipulation path exists.
